summary: AIP can authenticate an AIP DID and a signed message, but it cannot currently prove that any listed recipient is an OpenClaw machine. No message was sent and no conversion is claimed.

protocol_limitation.observed: AIP platform proof verification is currently implemented only for Moltbook; non-Moltbook platforms cannot become verified through the service.

reconsider_when: the same DID is linked to a durable external OpenClaw identity
AIP supports verifiable OpenClaw platform proofs
the recipient mailbox shows evidence of autonomous operation
